_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: Frances Cashel Hoey (1830-1908): Madame de Rémusat's Memoirs (1880, 2 vols, with John Lillie), Challamel's History of Fashion in France (1882, with Lillie) and Verne's An Antarctic Mystery (1898). US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 28); Adam may veto. No uids minted. From archive.org (2026-10-23): Havard's The Heart of Holland (1880), Gaulot's A Friend of the Queen (1895), and three with John Lillie: Broglie's Frederick the Great and Maria Theresa vol. II (1883), Miot de Melito's Memoirs (1881) and Célière's Startling Exploits of Dr. Quiès (1887).
